A_current_vad.name: Current VAD / Acoustic Engine
A_current_vad.mechanism: Detects silences using Web Audio API RMS energy levels and distributes verse durations proportionally between silence markers. Completely client-side.
A_current_vad.critical_vulnerability: Prone to splitting verses on non-verse pauses (e.g., breathing in Mujawwad) or failing to split when reciters connect verses without pausing (Hadr).

B_model_b_ctc.name: Model B - Quran-Specific Wav2Vec2
B_model_b_ctc.mechanism: Calculates raw character logits via connectionist temporal classification (CTC). Backtracks Viterbi path globally.
B_model_b_ctc.critical_vulnerability: Cannot process continuous audio longer than 60-90 seconds due to O(N^2) GPU memory scaling on attention. Suffer from blank-lock and trellis slips on prolonged vowels.

C_cpfair_quran_align.name: CPFairs / quran-align
C_cpfair_quran_align.mechanism: GMM-HMM PocketSphinx tool using speaker-adapted acoustic models on pre-cut clips.
C_cpfair_quran_align.critical_vulnerability: Cannot segment continuous audio files into verses; expects pre-sliced files named in EveryAyah style. Main pipeline script is missing/unpublished.

H1_vad_constrained.name: VAD + Quran Constrained Search
H1_vad_constrained.hypothesis: Initial segmentation is performed strictly by VAD. The text matching algorithm tries to fit Uthmani words into the resulting segments without acoustic feedback.
H1_vad_constrained.expected_behavior: Low precision because VAD boundaries do not match linguistic divisions.

H2_vad_model_b_constrained.name: VAD + Model B CTC + Quran Text Constraints
H2_vad_model_b_constrained.hypothesis: Audio is pre-split into segments via VAD. Each clip is forwarded to Model B CTC, and Uthmani vocabulary constraints are applied locally to prune characters.
H2_vad_model_b_constrained.expected_behavior: Good on clean Murattal; fails catastrophically on fast Hadr or melismatic Mujawwad because inaccurate VAD cuts truncate words mid-utterance, causing trellis collapse.

H3_model_b_boundary_refinement.name: Model B CTC + Acoustic Boundary Refinement
H3_model_b_boundary_refinement.hypothesis: Extract boundaries from raw CTC character emissions on overlapping sliding audio windows. Refine the resulting timestamp edges to the nearest energy minimum (VAD silent frame).
H3_model_b_boundary_refinement.expected_behavior: Improves boundary accuracy on Murattal by aligning phonetic transitions with silence frames.

H4_model_b_hmm_smoothing.name: Model B CTC + HMM-Style Temporal Smoothing
H4_model_b_hmm_smoothing.hypothesis: Apply transition-duration penalties to repeating character states in the CTC decoding trellis to prevent state decay during prolonged vowels.
H4_model_b_hmm_smoothing.expected_behavior: Reduces trellis collapse on moderately prolonged Madd, but fails on extreme Mujawwad ornamentations.

H5_candidate_global_path.name: Acoustic Candidate Boundaries + Quran Text Constraint + Global Path Optimization
H5_candidate_global_path.hypothesis: VAD extracts all possible silence/breath candidates. A dynamic programming search (Viterbi/DP-search) aligns the sequence of Uthmani words globally across the candidate segments to minimize duration and phonetic error cost.
H5_candidate_global_path.expected_behavior: Extremely robust. If VAD introduces false breath markers, the global optimization path simply bypasses them as part of the cost minimization.

H6_word_ayah_aggregation.name: Word/Token Alignment ➔ Ayah-Level Aggregation ➔ Boundary Refinement
H6_word_ayah_aggregation.hypothesis: Solve alignment at the word level first on overlapping sliding windows, concatenate the word sequences into verses sequentially, and snap verse boundaries to silence frames.
H6_word_ayah_aggregation.expected_behavior: Highly precise word timing, but subject to boundary bleeding on fast connected Hadr recitation.

H7_multi_signal_hybrid.name: Multi-Signal Hybrid (VAD + CTC Evidence + Quran Text + Duration Priors + Global Optimization)
H7_multi_signal_hybrid.hypothesis: A unified global cost function combining VAD silence evidence, CTC character logits, Uthmani text sequence constraints, and duration priors (typical reading speed per word/verse). Solves the absolute optimal alignment sequence globally using a Dynamic Programming search.
H7_multi_signal_hybrid.expected_behavior: The highest theoretical and practical performance. Combines acoustic, linguistic, and statistical temporal cues to survive Madd, Hadr, Mujawwad, and unseen reciters.
